articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Qǐngwèn, jǐdiǎn zhōng kāi?
MR. ANDERSON: May I ask, what time does it leave?
SHÒUPIÀOYUÁN: Shíbādiǎn wǔshiwǔfēn fā chē. Qǐng ni bǎ nǐde hùzhào gěi wo.
TICKET CLERK: It departs at 1855. Please give me your passport.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Hǎo, gěi ni. Dào Shànghǎi qùde chē zài dìjǐ zhàntái?
MR. ANDERSON: Okay, here it is. On which platform is the train to Shànghǎi?
SHÒUPIÀOYUÁN: Zài dìyī zhàntái. Bú yòng jí. Hái zǎo ne.
TICKET CLERK: On Platform Number 1. No need to be anxious. It's still early.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Wǒ zhèijiàn xíngli zěnme bàn?
MR. ANDERSON: What should I do about this suitcase of mine?
SHÒUPIÀOYUÁN: Kěyi bǎ xíngli náshang chē qu.
TICKET CLERK: You may take the suitcase onto the train.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Zhèibān chē yǒu cānchē ba?
MR. ANDERSON: This train has a dining car, I suppose?
SHÒUPIÀOYUÁN: Yǒu. Yǒu Zhōngcān, yě yǒu Xīcān.
TICKET CLERK: Yes. There's Chinese food and also Western food.
